summary: Smaller default asynchronous pages with retained writer-cost counterexamples

replay.detail: No automatic open/read/repair replay; explicit pages drain a captured delta queue.

schema.detail: The explicit asynchronous runtime defaults to eight rows per page; existing compatible files retain their pinned limits and require explicit compatible configuration.

rules.detail: Canonical/admission/checkpoint rules unchanged. Unsupported rank/repair and local adapters fence or are refused.

compatibility.detail: Async default page size is eight. Caller-specified limits remain explicit and must match the installed file.

downtime.detail: No live restart or existing-store conversion.

manual.detail: Retains both local cost probes, including the 115.822 ms 32-output target miss. Consumer writer bounds remain unqualified.

recovery.detail: Quota overflow, capture loss, incompatible metadata and unsupported mutation require explicit recovery; no automatic rebuild. Production authority, checkpoint, retention and ordered operators remain gates.
